name: conversation-details
title: Conversation Details
description: A conversation's details, e.g. where it runs, its branch and changes, its subagents: a card of sections (a small grey heading with a count after it and a menu at its end, hairlines between them) of 32px rows, each an icon with a grey status mark at its corner (a spinner while running), its value with an optional muted label before it ("Effort High"), plain rows for facts that are not controls, mono meta at its end ("+38 −12", "19s"), a chevron or an icon button of its own, as a button, link or menu trigger. Pinned at the top right of the conversation's area, over the margin beside its column, where there is room, and shown and hidden by a button in the header; else that button opens it as a popover under it. It scrolls inside, no taller than the area. The app gives every row and word. The pinned card 192px, 3 columns and a gutter.
